title: Enforce the F0 route invariant at every boundary
objective: Reject any F0 Program whose route is not UNSELECTED at model construction, schema validation, and Ledger persistence boundaries.
forbidden_actions: read or reuse credentials from chat
commit directly to a protected baseline
change a formal Foundry Program stage
authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or production action

acceptance_criteria.description: Direct model construction of F0 with a preselected route fails.
Schema-level validation of F0 with a preselected route fails.
Direct Ledger/persistence insertion cannot bypass the invariant.
A governed later-stage route selection remains representable.
Existing tests and schema-drift validation remain green.

protected_actions: approve or merge the pull request
configure repository visibility or branch protection
